text:
leah_sales: Quick notecustomer requires an air-gapped POC: no outbound egress, USB-only updates, monthly deltas, strict signing + chain-of-custody. How do we price and operate?

maria_se: We have operator-free install flows (tarball + systemd / containerd compose). Feature gaps: autoscaling and KV refresh needs operator hooks.

dmitri_infra: Technical limits: quantized model shards may be >20GB. For <2GB monthly deltas we need an initial full seed transfer by ship, then deltas for configs/weights where patching supported.

olivia_sols: Proposal: two tracks: (A) self-serve signed bundles + docs (one-time packaging fee), (B) managed sealed updates: we validate, sign, and ship monthly (recurring fee). Emergency outside-window patches are billable.

leah_sales: Customer also requires FIPS HSM signing. Can they sign on-prem and upload detached sigs?

dmitri_infra: Yes. We can provide unsigned artifacts and a small signing CLI. They sign with their HSM and provide detached signatures we ingest. No private key sharing.

security_bot: Provide SBOM (CycloneDX), detached sha256 sigs, signed release manifest. Recommend quarterly CVE snapshots and signed attestation per shipment.

maria_se: Ops note: no telemetry = more manual support. Add retainer for support + potential on-site windows.

leah_sales: Action items: maria draft SOW/pricing, dmitri confirm full-seed size for their target model, olivia produce chain-of-custody template, security document HSM workflow. I'll send draft to customer EOD Thursday.
